description: This file contains shell functions related to Git repository management, including creating commits, parsing commit IDs, formatting outputs for user readability, and comparing references. It appears to be a collection of utility functions used in shell scripting for version control automation.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns each commit's object ID to a variable named after the commit.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated version of a given object ID.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats the output of Git commands to be more user-friendly and stable by replacing commit IDs and other environment-specific data.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters the formatted output, limiting output lines as specified.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Processes and saves expected output by cleaning up the input lines.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git references with expected output, ensuring consistency.
